-- A negative counter deliberately fails its CHECK. Keep psql open so ROLLBACK can run.
\set ON_ERROR_STOP off
\set VERBOSITY verbose
UPDATE portfolio."account" SET "p3_processed_count" = -1 WHERE "account_id" IS NOT DISTINCT FROM 2001 RETURNING json_build_object('processed_count',"p3_processed_count");
